about: The first Ministry duty (docs/story/DUTIES.md, Game/GameQuarry.cs): after the warden's induction, the Ministry sends a new inmate by crew bus to the Ministry Quarry, where the machines are taught on the job (Karl, 2026-11-10: the induction is about the person; machines come in stages, working for the Ministry). Each step's cue is judged on the host. Cues: reach (stand within amount m of the spot), ride (board the crew bus at the spot's stop and ride it to the other: spot colony or quarry), power (lay a power cable at the quarry's machines), feed (tip what you carry into the quarry's Materials Bin), recipe (set the quarry Assembler's recipe), wait (seconds). Spots: stop (the colony's bus stop), quarry (the quarry's bus stop), genset, bin, assembler (the quarry's). Text is ASCII; {Action} is the player's own key. The bus is a STAND-IN (Source/StandIns) until the vehicle redo.
speaker: Foreman Grubb
memo: Inmate {name}: you are assigned to the Ministry Quarry. Report to the bus stop outside the colony gate. The crew bus will collect you.

report.title: Report to the bus stop
report.text: Your first Ministry duty: the quarry. Go to the bus stop outside the colony gate (the orange marker) and wait for the crew bus.

steps.title: The crew bus
steps.text: The crew bus is on its way. When it has stopped, walk up to it to board. Company-approved transport: do not touch anything.
steps.say: Bus is coming, inmate. Stand still and try to look employable.

steps.title: Power the works
steps.text: The quarry's Assembler has a genset but no cable. Take out the linking tool ({Streak2}), press {Fire} on the genset's power port, then {Fire} on the Assembler's to run a power cable. {Aim} takes the last node off.
steps.say: Welcome to the quarry. I'm Foreman Grubb. First job: the works are dead. Run a cable from the genset to the Assembler.
steps.hint: Aim the linking tool at the genset (the orange marker) until it names its power port, press {Fire}, then do the same on the Assembler.

steps.title: Your quota
steps.text: Dig some ground with the ground drill (hold {Fire} on bare ground), then aim at the quarry's Materials Bin and press {Interact} to tip in what you carry.
steps.say: Quota time. Dig, then tip it in the bin. The bin feeds the Assembler, the Assembler feeds the Ministry.
steps.hint: Ground drill out, hold {Fire} on the ground for a few seconds, then {Interact} on the Materials Bin (the orange marker).

steps.title: The Assembler
steps.text: The Assembler makes parts from what its bin and shelf hold. Take out the configure tool and press {Fire} on the Assembler to pick a recipe. It shows what each one needs.
steps.say: Pick something to make. Most of it wants steel, and steel is the smelter's job. That's another duty, another day.
steps.hint: Configure tool out, aim at the Assembler (the orange marker) and press {Fire}, then pick any recipe.

steps.title: Back to the colony
steps.text: That's the shift. Wait at the quarry's bus stop and board the crew bus back to the colony.
steps.say: Not bad, for a convict. Bus back is at the stop. Don't miss it: the next one is in a fortnight.

steps.title: Duty done
steps.text: First duty done: the quarry's works run on your cable. The Ministry will call you for the next one.
steps.say: Noted on your file. Favourably, which is rare. Don't let it go to your head.
